_what: Water bodies with a station-level statistical model in the second water plans, by this project's water-body id. The id is DKCOAST followed by DHI's water-body number (checked by name for every entry below). Replaces the six-letter name match in scripts/areas.py, which flagged water bodies DHI does not list and missed some it does.
_source: DHI-MODEL-DEL1-2015 (pinned), section 3.2, Tabel 5: 'Oversigt over vandområder og de tilhørende overvågningsstationer, der er opstillet statistiske modeller for'
_matched: 2026-09-11, by DHI's number, each name read against marin_overordnet's ov_navn. Where the names differ in wording it is noted.
